messages:
Maya Ortiz: Quick preflight for launch post + webinar. Need canonical decision (/register vs /guestlist), 3 campaign redirects, JSON-LD Event, and 3 meta variants. 10 min?

Kevin Patel: I can own redirects. 302 for promos, 301 only for permanent archive moves. Will include rollback notes and nginx-safe rules.

Samir Rao: Ill handle JSON-LD + OG/Twitter tags and add FAQ markup. Will include a unit test that asserts JSON-LD presence in staging.

Elaine Park: Pulling target keywords from the benchmark narrative and drafting 3 meta descriptions tuned to intent clusters. Dropping in the content doc in a bit.

Kevin Patel: Draft redirect rules (first pass):
/webinar/social -> /guestlist?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=launch 302
/guestlist/submit -> /register?utm_source=guestlist_form&utm_campaign=launch 302
/blog/webinar-2026 -> /register?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=archive 301
Rollback: remove campaign params or revert to prior target if issues.

Maya Ortiz: Canonical policy: /register is primary canonical for the event. /guestlist remains self-canonical unless content parity >80%, then canonical-> /register.

seo-bot: staging-crawl scheduled for 2026-04-08T03:00Z. Results will post to #marketing-crawl-results.

Maya Ortiz: Action owners: Kevin - redirects PR; Samir - JSON-LD + tests; Elaine - meta copy. Reconvene Tue 9am to verify PRs and crawl. Ping here if blocked. :thumbsup:
